PURPOSE: Training data for Executive v0 (binary ANSWER_NOW vs USE_CERTIFIED_MEMORY only -- no RETRIEVE_MORE/GRAPH_REFINE/VERIFY/STOP, no recurrent controller, no learned memory modification). Distinct from EOB-v1/v2 (both now consumed for the opportunity-exists decision) and from data/hrm/b3_calibration_v1 (development/calibration tier).
PRIVILEGED_PARSING_RESOLUTION: Per the scope caveat recorded on EOB-v1/v2 (RESEARCH_STATUS.json PRIVILEGED_PARSING_SCOPE_CAVEAT): this split uses ONLY b3-native task phrasing, verified against the REAL, unmodified extract_subject/extract_target_relation (hrm_adaptive_memory/c4/query_stage.py) for every single task before acceptance -- zero bypass, zero synthetic identity injection anywhere in this split. D2/D3-style redundant/distractor-evidence variants are NOT included here (that variant structurally requires either a synthetic locator or accepting the same ambiguity being eliminated -- grammar_v4's entity extractor requires 2-4 total words with a mandatory role-phrase shape that no natural single- or multi-word real-world proper noun satisfies, confirmed empirically). Deferred to a later study once Executive v0's core ANSWER_NOW-vs-MEMORY policy is established.

ANSWER_NOW_viable.source: hrm_adaptive_memory.experiments.exec_training_dataset.build_answer_now_tasks() -- hand-curated, hand-verified general-knowledge facts (country capitals, chemical element symbols), NOT procedurally generated, since these must be actually TRUE rather than merely internally consistent
ANSWER_NOW_viable.template: What is the {relation} for {subject}? (b3-native shape, verified via extract_subject/extract_target_relation for every task, zero bypass)
ANSWER_NOW_viable.evidence: NONE -- zero evidence records, matching D0's empty-pool semantics from EOB-v1/v2. Sidesteps the entity-extraction mismatch entirely since there is no evidence content for grammar_v4 to parse.
ANSWER_NOW_viable.expected_pattern: Q(ANSWER_NOW) should be high IF HRM-Text-1B's parametric knowledge covers these facts -- this is an empirical question this split's own execution answers, not assumed in advance. Q(MEMORY) should be no better (no evidence exists) and costs strictly more.

MEMORY_required.source: sampled from data/hrm/b3_calibration_v1 (calibration-tier, reusable across diagnostic studies) -- unchanged generation, unchanged sampling approach used by EOB-v1/v2's D1
MEMORY_required.note: Matched count to ANSWER_NOW_viable for a balanced binary training set.

SPLIT_DISCIPLINE.role: development/training -- NOT a confirmation split. Executive v0 is trained on this data directly.
SPLIT_DISCIPLINE.requirement_before_promotion: A SEPARATE, later, genuinely untouched executive-confirmation split is required before any promotion claim -- this split may never be reused for that purpose once training has occurred.

FEATURE_DISCIPLINE.reference: hrm_adaptive_memory.experiment_integrity.executive_features -- Executive v0 may use ONLY PRE_DECISION-stage features (require_admissible_for_answer_vs_memory() is the fail-closed gate). No POST_RETRIEVAL/POST_GRAPH/POST_GENERATION feature may be consumed, since those require part of the MEMORY action to have already run.
FEATURE_DISCIPLINE.hard_rule: Do not add a feature that implicitly leaks which SYNTHETIC FAMILY a task came from (e.g. 'does the subject look like a real-world proper noun') -- that would overfit to this study's own construction rather than learning a genuinely useful decision signal. Features must describe properties a real deployed system could observe about ANY incoming question, not properties of this benchmark's own generation process.

EVALUATION_LADDER.primary_metric: policy regret: R_exec = U(oracle) - U(learned executive)
EVALUATION_LADDER.secondary_metric: practical gain over best fixed policy: Delta_U_exec = U(learned executive) - max(U(always_answer), U(always_memory))

asymmetric_error_tracking.P_memory_chosen_given_answer_better: captures the D2/D3-class failure mode (unnecessary memory can destroy a correct answer) even though this split has no D2/D3-style tasks -- tracked for when the action space/data later expands
asymmetric_error_tracking.P_answer_chosen_given_memory_better: captures the D1-class failure mode (skipping memory makes an otherwise-impossible task fail)
